primary_metric: All four value siblings correct within each fixed question/variant; also report current/protected/initial joint competence and all-twelve per four-value variant.
requirements: Audit executable truth and complete six-family coverage before inference. Reproduce every registered prompt ID hash and all non-value token/position identity.
Preserve normal full historical attention and native recurrent computation. Use full prefill and unrestricted greedy decoding; candidate scoring is NLL-only.
Use all validation examples in the fixed registered order; no training or budget selection and no original-test/70000-series inference.

Report per-family/variant/role results, independent and necessary-order behavior, unchanged protected/initial truths, and before-to-after regressions. These are functional diagnostics; position changes and downstream computation prevent a write-damage attribution.
Do not enable a learned controller or oracle dependency labels at inference. Register any later matched shared/independent/local training separately.
interpretation: First mainline value-paired multi-entity baseline after carrier/readout calibration. It neither assumes recurrent-state damage nor presupposes a shared-interface advantage.
